content: Patients with high-risk neuroblastoma are classified as follows: 1. Individuals diagnosed with stage 2A, 2B, 3, 4, or 4S neuroblastoma, regardless of their age or tumor grade, if the tumor exhibits MYCN gene amplification. 2. Patients with stage 3 neuroblastoma who are 547 days of age or older, have unfavorable tumor histology, and do not exhibit MYCN gene amplification. 3. Patients with stage 4 neuroblastoma who are between 365 and 547 days of age, have unfavorable tumor histology, a DNA index of 1, and no MYCN gene amplification. 4. Patients with stage 4 neuroblastoma who are older than 547 days, regardless of tumor grade, irrespective of whether MYCN gene amplification is present or absent.
